notes: New: the ink-visibility guarantee now covers EVERY color — light pink, red, orange, yellow and green writing is darkened within its own hue so every stroke prints clearly visible and stays whole (light blue already did since the last release)

Fixed: light-colored writing can no longer be cut out by B&W/grayscale thresholding or stain cleanup — the boost runs before every rule that could erase it, and background washes are still cleaned to white thanks to a new spatial wash detector
New: update popup — when the installed app is out of date, a centered dialog appears with a big “Refresh now” button that clears the old cache and reloads straight onto the new version
Improved: “Everything a student needs” is now a compact chip list (hover a chip for details) instead of a tall card grid, and the stray progress bars at the bottom of the How-it-works cards are gone
